Context: Procedural requirements for easy settlement of claims

- (vii) agencies only.
- (viii) Submit your claim within three months after completion of return journey, if no advance is drawn and within one month after completion of journey, if advance is drawn. Belated claims can be processed by Ministries I Departments with the concurrence of the Financial Advisor by relaxing the provisions.
- GID (13), Rule 13.
